source.address_shape_binding: Existing GraphTensor snapshots and captured closure arguments bind fixed addresses/strides/shapes; Graph run exposes no dynamic operand/address-update API. Current per-forward tensors and run N/R/offsets differ, so persistent cross-forward replay is not available by simply storing this graph.
source.single_invocation_amortization: Per-run capture+instantiate then one execution has no established benefit. Repeated fixed-buffer component replay can be a diagnostic only, and cannot by itself establish Model speedup.

hard_blocker.graph_behavior: Current Graph::instantiate partitions capture-safe versus explicit host replay. Required QK/PV stay individually invoked host RecordedCalls; any capture-safe softmax segment cannot capture the surrounding small Gemms. Transitions from device segment to host segment may additionally synchronize. require_device_graph means some safe segment, not that every Gemm is captured. Softmax capture policy need not be researched further to establish this blocker.

decision: STOP; no patch/build/GPU/SDK changes. Enabling graph provider qualification or introducing persistent fixed-buffer scheduling and binding would be a separate authorized engineering task, not the requested existing-interface minimal A/C. Do not force capture_safe=true, change Gemm shape, use raw stream capture bypassing Runtime lifetime, or describe host replay as GPU launch elimination.
